service.description: What a user (the current user; another only with authorization disabled) may do in a room. level: 0 none, 1 read (a public room, or a record room whose record the user may see, without being a member), 2 member, 3 moderator, 4 owner; 0 for an external user (EXTERNAL_USER) in a record room, a member too, and in a public room they are not in. canRead, canJoin (not a member and may join; not archived), canPost (a member of a room that is not archived), canModerate (level 3 and up in a room that is not direct), isOwner. room is the room as find#Rooms lists it (null when not found or not readable); member the user's member row (null when none). Adds no error for a room the user cannot reach, so a caller may use it as a check.

Whether the current user may see a record, so they may read and join the room bound to it: the service the user's qapps theme names in STRT_RECORD_VISIBLE_SERVICE (found as the shell counts service is) is called as the user, with the caller's authorization and entity filters, with recordEntityName, recordId and checkOnly true, and answers recordVisible. No such theme value: false (only members reach record rooms, and only managers a records drive's record folders, FileServices.check#RecordPaths), logged once. A service that fails or answers no recordVisible: false, logged once. Adds no error. The hook runs in the caller's transaction, so it sees records the caller made; with checkOnly it must answer without an error, which would mark that transaction rollback-only (docs/Services.md). userId asks for another user, only with authorization disabled (else false, logged): the hook of that user's theme runs as that user, with authorization on, in the caller's transaction. An external user (EXTERNAL_USER), current or asked for: false, no hook asked.

Internal: the users of userIdList (the current user when empty) who hold the framework permission EXTERNAL_USER (outside users: an app's client contacts), whom chat keeps out of record rooms, public rooms they are not in and others' presence, and the drives out of a records drive. A user whose rows cannot be read counts as external.

Internal: send message to the users of userIdList on a chat topic (chatRoom:id, chatUser:userId or userStatus) as a NotificationMessage that is not persisted and shows no alert; after the caller's transaction commits (nothing on a rollback), and at once outside one. An external user (EXTERNAL_USER) is left out of the pushes of a record room and of the presence of other users on userStatus.

Internal: add an event to a room's timeline with the room's next eventSeq, and push it to the room's members on chatRoom:id (unless noPush). The caller has checked access. A message of the main timeline (no threadRootEventSeq) becomes the room's last message. event is the event as pushed: get#Timeline's shape without the aggregates. memberUserIdList are the users it was pushed to.

Internal: a change of a message that is no event of its own (its link previews, its poll's votes), pushed to the room's members on chatRoom:id and not stored: {kind: 'update', chatRoomId, eventSeq, threadRootEventSeq, fields}, where fields are the message's fields as get#Timeline gives them. Every member gets the same fields, so nothing of one user's own (a poll's mine) is in them. The caller has checked access.
Internal: send these users their shell counts after their chat counts changed. Failure tolerant: an error is logged, not returned.

actions.script: const users = Array.from(new Set((userIdList || []).filter((id) => id))) if (!users.length) return ec.message.pushErrors() ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ShellServices.publish#ShellCounts').parameter('userIdList', users).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) ec.logger.warn(`Could not publish the shell counts of ${users.join(', ')}: ${ec.message.errorsString}`) ec.message.clearErrors() ec.message.popErrors()

service.description: Internal: put a message in the search index (the MoquiChatEvent document), or take it out (remove, or a message that is redacted). Nothing without search. Failure tolerant: an error is logged.

The current user's rooms (another user's only with authorization disabled), pinned first, then by the last event. Each: the room's fields, displayName (a direct room's: the other members' names), isMember, my roleEnumId, notificationLevelEnumId, isPinned, isMuted, lastReadEventSeq, unreadCount (messages from others after my read marker), mentionCount, lastMessage {eventSeq, senderUserId, senderName, sentDate, snippet}, and for a direct room otherUserIdList and, with one other member, otherUserId and presence (as get#UserStatuses gives it). filter: unread (unread messages or mentions), mentions, direct, rooms (private and public), records; searchText matches the name and topic. includeJoinable adds the public rooms the user has not joined (isMember false). unreadTotal and mentionTotal add up the listed rooms. An external user (EXTERNAL_USER) gets no record room and no joinable room.

A room the user may read, with its members (current ones; memberList each {userId, name, roleEnumId, joinedDate, lastReadEventSeq}), the user's member row and what the user may do (as get#RoomAccess). By chatRoomId, or by recordEntityName and recordId for the room bound to that record (room null, and no error, when there is none or the user may not read it: a record's Chatter asks so). A member whose preference CHAT_READ_RECEIPTS is N has no lastReadEventSeq (null) for others.

A room with the current user in it. roomTypeEnumId (or its code): CrtDirect (direct) with the other users of memberUserIdList, one room per set of users: the existing one is answered (created false) and the user is back in it; CrtPrivate or CrtPublic (roomName required) with memberUserIdList as members; CrtRecord with recordEntityName and recordId, one room per record: the existing one is answered and the user joins it if they may (a user must be able to see the record, check#RecordVisible, to make it). The maker is the owner (in a direct room every member is a member). visibilityEnumId follows the type (direct and private CrvMembers, public CrvUsers, record CrvRecord); a record room may be CrvMembers. Each member's notification level starts at the member's own default, the preference CHAT_NOTIFY_DEFAULT (all, mentions or none), else CnlAll, CnlMentions in a public room; in a direct room it is CnlAll. Each new member's room list hears of it on chatUser:userId. No external user (EXTERNAL_USER) makes or is put in a record room.

Internal: the default notification level of each user who set one, the preference CHAT_NOTIFY_DEFAULT (all, mentions or none; another value or none is left out), as the notificationLevelEnumId a new membership starts with (create#Room, add#Member). Read for users other than the current one, so from their UserPreference rows.

parameter.name: levelMap
parameter.description: userId to CnlAll, CnlMentions or CnlNone

service.description: Internal: of userIdList, those who show the text of a chat message in its notifications, and those who do not: the preference CHAT_NOTIFY_PREVIEW of N leaves it out (the ChatMention notification says who mentioned them and where, not what); Y or none shows it.
Internal: of userIdList, those who turned read receipts off (the preference CHAT_READ_RECEIPTS of N): their read markers are not pushed to the room nor shown to others.

Internal: the ChatMention notification of a message to the users it mentions (send#Message, edit#Message): reason mention, the room as its record, the room's link, and the message's first 120 characters as summary, which a user whose CHAT_NOTIFY_PREVIEW is N does not get (their notification's title is who mentioned them where, without the text). Failure tolerant: a notification that cannot be sent is logged.

Change a room (not a direct room): its name, topic and avatar (a moderator or owner), its visibility (CrvMembers or CrvUsers, CrvRecord for a record room), retention and archive (the owner). A change of name, topic or archive is a system event; the members' room lists hear of it on chatUser:userId.

Add users to a room, or join it. With no userId and no userIdList the current user joins a room they may join (a public room, or a record room whose record they may see). A member adds others to a room that is not direct (a direct room's members are fixed: start another direct message) and not archived; a role other than member, or an agent's agentRef, takes a moderator (owner for CmrOwner). A user who left comes back. A new member starts with everything before read, at their own default notification level (the preference CHAT_NOTIFY_DEFAULT: all, mentions or none), else CnlAll, CnlMentions in a public room; one who comes back keeps the level they had. Each is a membership event; the added users' room lists hear of it on chatUser:userId. An external user (EXTERNAL_USER) is never added to a record room.

Leave a room (userId empty or the current user), or take another member out (a moderator or owner; an owner only by an owner). Leaving a direct room hides it until its next message, with no event. When the last owner leaves a room that still has members, the longest-standing moderator, else member, becomes its owner. A membership event; the user's room list hears of it on chatUser:userId.

Give a member a role (not in a direct room): an owner gives any role, a moderator makes members and moderators of those who are not owners. A room keeps at least one owner. agentRef (a moderator) names the service an agent member's messages go to. A membership event.

The current user's own settings in a room: notificationLevelEnumId (or its code: all, mentions, none), isMuted and isPinned. A setting not given stays. The user's other tabs hear of it on chatUser:userId.

A page of a room's timeline, oldest first, for a user who may read the room (a public room's or a visible record room's without joining). By chatRoomId, or by recordEntityName and recordId for the room bound to that record (room null and an empty list, no error, when there is none or the user may not read it: Chatter asks so).
Paging by eventSeq: the latest limit events; beforeSeq for the ones before it; afterSeq for the ones after it; aroundSeq for limit events around it (a search hit, a mention). hasMoreBefore and hasMoreAfter say whether there are more. The main timeline leaves thread replies out (a thread root has threadReplyCount and threadLastDate, threadLastEventSeq and threadLastUserId); threadRootEventSeq gives that thread: the root and its replies. pinnedOnly gives the pinned messages, newest first. eventSeq gives that one event (a thread reply too), or none.
Shown: messages, membership, pin, call, poll and system events. Edits are applied (body is the latest, edited true, editedDate), reactions are aggregated (reactions [{key, count, userIds, mine}]), a redacted message is redacted true with no body, bodyText or attachments and removedLabel "Message removed", and a reply has replyTo {eventSeq, senderUserId, senderName, snippet, redacted}. A message has forwardOf (a forwarded message, see send#Message), poll (get#PollStates, with the user's own votes), linkPreviews [{url, title, description, siteName}] and, for the user's own message, clientRef. Also the room, the user's access and lastReadEventSeq, and memberList (as get#Room: each member's lastReadEventSeq gives the read markers).

The threads of a room, the one with the latest reply first, for a user who may read the room: each root message {eventSeq, senderUserId, senderName, snippet, sentDate, redacted, threadReplyCount, threadLastDate, threadLastEventSeq, threadLastUserId, threadLastUserName, lastSnippet}. mine keeps the threads the user started or replied in. Paged by beforeDate (the threadLastDate of the last one listed); hasMore says whether there are more.

A message from the current user (a member of the room, which is not archived). body is safe HTML (the m-rich-text light value: mentions are span data-mention-id); a message needs a body or attachments (chatAttachmentIdList, files the sender uploaded to this room with upload#Attachment and not yet sent). replyToEventSeq quotes a message of the room; threadRootEventSeq puts it in a thread (a reply's root is its own root). recordList [{entity, id}] names records the message is about (record cards). Mentions are counted and notified (see the file's notes); roomUrl is the notification's link. In a direct room the members who left are back. The message is indexed for search; the sender has read it; the counts of the members it counts for are published; agent members get it (deliver#AgentMessage). senderUserId sends as another user (an agent's reply), only with authorization disabled.
clientRef (^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$) is the sender's own reference of the message, kept on it and in its push, so a client matches its pending copy; a send with a clientRef the sender already used in the room is answered with that message and duplicate true, and sends nothing (a retry after a lost answer). An @room mention (data-mention-id "@room") mentions every current member, from a moderator or owner, or from anyone in a room of 20 members or fewer; else it is plain text.
forwardOfChatRoomId and forwardOfEventSeq forward a message (not redacted) of a room the sender is a member of: content.forwardOf {senderUserId, senderName, sentDate, body, bodyText} is made here from it, so it cannot be forged, with its mentions inert (no data-mention-id) and nothing of its room; its files are copied into this room, each on its own (one that cannot be copied is logged and left out). body is then an optional comment.
Once it commits, the previews of its links are fetched (fetch#LinkPreviews, pushed as an update), unless the property chat_link_previews is false or the sender's preference CHAT_LINK_PREVIEWS is N. Out: eventSeq and event (as pushed).

Change the text of one's own message (not redacted) within the edit window: the property chat_edit_window_minutes, 1440 by default, 0 for no limit. An edit event with the new body and mentions; the message keeps its place, shows the new text and is edited. New mentions are counted and notified, dropped ones no longer count (@room as send#Message has it). The search index has the new text, and its link previews are fetched again unless the sender removed them. A poll is not edited.

Delete a message: one's own, or any (not in a direct room) as a moderator or owner. Its content, its edits' content, its files, its link previews and its poll go, its mentions no longer count, it leaves the search index, and the timeline shows "message removed" in its place (a redaction event, content {target: 'message', reason}). A thread reply leaves its thread's count, and its thread's last reply is the last one that stands.

Internal: what a message keeps beside its own row goes, for redact#Message and the retention (clean#RoomRetention): its mentions (no longer counted), its files (each file on its own: one that cannot be removed is logged), its poll's rows, its link previews and its search document. The caller has checked access, and changes or deletes the message row itself. mentionedUserIdList are the users it mentioned, whose counts change.

Toggle the current user's reaction key (an emoji, up to 32 characters) on a message: a reaction event when the user had none with that key, else that reaction is taken back (a redaction event, content {target: 'reaction', messageSeq, key}). A member of a room that is not archived.
Pin a message to the room (pinned true, the default) or unpin it: a member of a room that is not archived. A pin event (content {pinned}); nothing when it is already so.

Move the current user's read marker in a room: to eventSeq (the room's last event by default; a marker only moves forward), or with markUnread to just before eventSeq ("mark unread from here"). The user's other tabs hear of it on chatUser:userId and the room's members on chatRoom:id (read receipts, unless the user's preference CHAT_READ_RECEIPTS is N); the user's counts are published.
Read everything in the current user's rooms. The user's tabs hear of it on chatUser:userId ({kind: 'read', all: true}); the user's counts are published.

actions.script: roomCount = 0 const me = ec.user.userId if (!me) return const rows = Array.from(ec.entity.find('moqui.chat.ChatRoomMember').condition('userId', me).condition('leftDate', null).list()) if (!rows.length) return const lastOf = {} for (const room of ec.entity.find('moqui.chat.ChatRoom').condition('chatRoomId', 'in', rows.map((row) => row.chatRoomId)) .selectField('chatRoomId').selectField('lastEventSeq').list()) lastOf[room.chatRoomId] = Number(room.lastEventSeq || 0) const now = ec.user.nowTimestamp for (const row of rows) { const last = lastOf[row.chatRoomId] || 0 if (Number(row.lastReadEventSeq || 0) >= last) continue row.set('lastReadEventSeq', last) row.set('lastReadDate', now) row.update() roomCount++ } if (!roomCount) return ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.push#Signal').parameters({topic: 'chatUser:' + me, userIdList: [me], message: {kind: 'read', all: true}}).call() ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.publish#ChatCounts').parameter('userIdList', [me]).call()

service.description: A user's chat counts (the current user's; another's only with authorization disabled, as the shell counts services call it), for the shell counts' chat part: per room (roomCounts, chatRoomId to {unread, mentions, counted}) the messages from others after the read marker and the mentions among them, in the rooms the user is in that are not archived. counted is what the room adds to total: unread in a room whose level is CnlAll and that is not muted, the mentions in a room whose level is CnlMentions or that is muted, nothing at CnlNone. unread adds up the unread of the rooms that count it, mentions the mentions of the rooms that are not CnlNone, unreadRoomCount the rooms that add to total. An external user's (EXTERNAL_USER) record rooms count nothing.

Tell the room's other members that the current user is typing (typing true, the default) or stopped: {kind: 'typing', chatRoomId, userId, typing, statusText} on chatRoom:id. Nothing is stored; a client shows it for a few seconds unless it is sent again. statusText (up to 80 characters) says what the user does, as an agent member's "Looking up open orders…"; userId types as another member (an agent), only with authorization disabled.

Store a file for a message the current user is about to send in a room (a member of a room that is not archived), as dbresource://chat/(chatRoomId)/(chatAttachmentId)/(file name) (the property chat_attachment_root names another place than dbresource://chat). send#Message takes its chatAttachmentId; a file never sent goes after a day (clean#PendingAttachments).

A file of a room the current user may read, for a download transition (which sends the location): location, fileName, contentType, fileSize, chatRoomId, eventSeq. A file not yet sent only for the user who uploaded it.
Remove the chat files uploaded more than hours ago (24 by default) and never sent with a message. Each file is on its own: one that cannot be removed is logged and the rest go on.

The daily job of retention: in each room with retentionDays, the events older than that many days are deleted (clean#RoomRetention). Each room is on its own, in its own transaction: one that fails is logged and the rest go on. roomCount are the rooms done, deletedCount their events deleted, failedCount the rooms that failed.

Internal: delete a room's events older than its retentionDays, up to limit of them (the rest go on the next run). A message's mentions, files, poll, link previews and search document go with it (clear#MessageContent); an edit, reaction or redaction of an event deleted goes too, even when newer. A thread reply within the retention stays though its root goes. When the room's last message goes, its last message is the last one that stands. The members who had unread events among them get their counts. Without retentionDays nothing is deleted.

The files of a room's messages, newest first, for a user who may read the room: each {chatAttachmentId, eventSeq, attachmentSeq, fileName, contentType, fileSize, senderUserId, senderName, sentDate, threadRootEventSeq}. contentTypePrefix keeps those whose type starts with it (image/ for the pictures), searchText those whose name has it. Paged by beforeEventSeq; a page ends at a whole message, and nextBeforeEventSeq is where the next one starts (null at the end). A redacted message's files are gone.

A poll from the current user (a member of a room that is not archived): a message (send#Message, its body the question, content.poll) with 2 to 10 options (optionList, each up to 200 characters, the same option once), anonymous (who voted is not shown), multiple (more than one option may be chosen) and closesDate (when it stops taking votes). threadRootEventSeq and clientRef as send#Message has them. Its state is pushed as an update after the message (push#Update). Out: eventSeq and event, with poll.

Internal: the polls of these messages of a room, as pollMap eventSeq to {question, anonymous, multiple, closesDate, closedDate, closed, createdByUserId, voterCount, totalVotes, options [{id, text, voteCount, voterIds, mine}], mine [option ids]}. voterIds are empty for an anonymous poll. shared leaves out mine (the same state for every member, as push#Update sends it); else mine is the current user's own. The caller has checked access.

The current user's vote on a poll of a room they may post in, while it is open: optionIdList replaces the user's votes (one option, or several in a poll that takes them); an empty list takes the vote back. The state is pushed as an update (push#Update). Out: poll, with the user's own votes.
Close a poll before its time: its creator, or a moderator or owner of the room. It takes no more votes; the state is pushed as an update. Nothing when it is closed already. Out: poll.

Internal (an agent member's run, plans/LLM-A2A-Assist.md 4.13): a message of an agent member with a card, content.assist {kind (approval, question or reply), runId, conversationId, itemId (the approval or question), requesterUserId, requesterName, title, summary, rows (an approval's changes: field, label, current, proposed) or options (a question's), state (pending, then the decision: approved, rejected, executed, expired, answered; done for a reply)}, the pattern of content.poll. body is the text a client without cards shows. Sent as senderUserId (the agent's chat user), only with authorization disabled; threadRootEventSeq as send#Message. The card is pushed as an update after the message (push#Update, fields {assist}). Out: eventSeq.

Internal: change an agent card in place (its decision): fields (state, decision, decidedBy {userId, name}, channel, feedback, answer) merge into content.assist, and the card is pushed as an update. Only with authorization disabled. A message with no card is left alone.

actions.script: assist = null if (!ec.artifactExecution.authzDisabled()) { ec.message.addError('An agent card is changed by the agent runtime'); return } const row = ec.entity.find('moqui.chat.ChatEvent').condition('chatRoomId', chatRoomId).condition('eventSeq', eventSeq).forUpdate(true).one() if (!row || row.redactedDate) return const content = JSON.parse(row.contentJson || '{}') if (!content.assist) return const allowed = ['state', 'decision', 'decidedBy', 'channel', 'feedback', 'answer'] for (const key of allowed) if (fields[key] !== undefined && fields[key] !== null) content.assist[key] = fields[key] row.set('contentJson', JSON.stringify(content)) row.update() assist = content.assist ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.push#Update').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId, eventSeq: eventSeq, fields: {assist: assist}}).call()

service.description: Internal (send#Message, edit#Message): once the transaction commits, fetch the previews of the message's links (fetch#LinkPreviews, asynchronously), unless the property chat_link_previews is false, the sender's preference CHAT_LINK_PREVIEWS is N, or the body has no link. Failure tolerant: a fetch that cannot be queued is logged.

Internal: the previews of a message's links (extract#LinkUrls: at most 3), each from get#LinkPreview on its own (a link that cannot be read has no card, and is logged), kept on the message (linkPreviewJson) and pushed as an update {linkPreviews} (push#Update) when they changed. Nothing for a message redacted or whose previews its sender removed.

Internal: the preview of one link {url, title, description, siteName}, null when it has none (no title), from the ChatLinkPreview cache when fetched in the last 24 hours (the last hour for a link that could not be read), else read again with fetch#LinkPage and kept. urlHash is extract#LinkUrls's.
Internal: the links of a message's body to preview, as urlList [{url, urlHash}]: http or https, at most 3, not a /qapps link, not one with a user or password, not on a port other than 80 or 443.

Internal: read the head of the page at url for its preview: no internal address (also after a redirect), 5 seconds, the first 512 KB, 3 redirects to any host, text/html only, no image. Out: ok, title, description, siteName, error. Adds no error. The property chat_link_preview_service names a service asked in place of the network (url in; status, contentType and body out), for tests.
The sender removes the link previews of their own message: they go, and are not fetched again for it (on an edit). Pushed as an update {linkPreviews: []}.

Search the messages of the rooms the current user may read: the rooms they are in, the public rooms, and with chatRoomId one room they may read (a record room by its record). With search, the MoquiChatEvent document (filtered to those rooms: the user's rooms by id, the public ones by roomVisibilityEnumId), ranked by relevance; without search, the text of the messages (newest first). Each found message: chatRoomId, eventSeq, roomName, senderUserId, senderName, sentDate, snippet and highlight (with search).

The agent entry point (for the Assist port, mr-moqui Phase 13): hand a room message to an agent member, calling the service its agentRef names with chatRoomId, eventSeq, agentUserId, senderUserId, body, bodyText and threadRootEventSeq (the message is in the parameters, so the agent need not read it). send#Message runs it asynchronously for each agent member of the room but the sender. Without an agentRef nothing is done (logged). The agent replies with send#Message and senderUserId (authorization disabled). Failure tolerant: an error is logged.

The presence and status of users (any user's: presence is shown on every avatar), as statusMap, userId to {userId, presence, statusText, emoji, clearAtDate, inCall, lastActiveDate}. presence is offline without a heartbeat in the last 3 minutes and for an invisible user, else dnd or away as set, else away when the user has been idle for their CHAT_AUTO_AWAY_MINUTES preference (10 by default), else online. A clear-at time that has come clears the text and emoji and puts the status back to online (expire#UserStatuses writes it). With the current user among them, myStatus adds statusEnumId and status (online, away, dnd, invisible: what the user chose) and autoAwayMinutes. An external current user (EXTERNAL_USER) gets only their own: others are left out of statusMap.

Internal: publish a user's presence on the userStatus topic to the members of the rooms the user is in (and to the user's own tabs, with self true and status), when it changed since the last publish (UserStatus.lastPresence) or with force (a status text changed). Failure tolerant.

The current user's status, from the account menu: statusEnumId or status (online, away, dnd, invisible), statusText (up to 100 characters) with an emoji, and when it clears: clearAtDate, or clearAfterMinutes from now; a status not given stays, clearStatus clears the text, emoji and clear-at. Published on userStatus. Out: myStatus, as get#UserStatuses gives it.

The client's heartbeat (each minute while a page is open, and at once when the user comes back from idle): the user is connected now, and was last active idleSeconds ago (active true for now, false for not since the last beat). Presence changes are published on userStatus. Out: myStatus.

Internal: the last notification socket of the user on this server closed and none came back within 20 seconds (moqui-host notws.rs), so the user is offline now rather than when the heartbeat runs out: lastSeenDate is set past the offline window (3 minutes) and the change is published on userStatus (publish#UserStatus). Another user's only with authorization disabled. In a cluster the socket may be the last one on this node only: a page still open on another node sends its heartbeat within a minute, and the user is online again.

The frequent job of presence: a clear-at time that has come clears the status text and emoji and puts the status back to online; a user who was online, away or busy is published again when that changed (no heartbeat for 3 minutes is offline, idle past their auto-away minutes is away). Each user is on their own: one that fails is logged and the rest go on.
